props.heading: No questions. Not one.
props.text: If a formula is not right for your skin we collect it from your door and refund in full — even if the bottle is half empty. Skin is personal; a return is not a failure.

steps.title: Open the order
steps.text: Find it in your archive and choose Return. Tell us which pieces and, if you like, why.
steps.label: Within 60 days

steps.title: We book the courier
steps.text: A collection slot is offered for the next working day. No printer, no label, no queue.
steps.label: Same day

steps.title: Hand it over
steps.text: Reuse the original box or any box. The courier scans it at your door and that is your proof.
steps.label: At your door

steps.title: Refunded in full
steps.text: We release the refund the moment it is collected — not when it reaches us.
steps.label: 2–3 days to your bank

yesItems: A shade that turned out wrong
